lead.en: Kamphaeng Phet (MRT BL12, opened 2004) is the market's own station: Exit 1-2 drop into Chatuchak Weekend Market's 35 acres, Exit 3 into Or Kor Tor's graded, air-conditioned produce halls, and bus bays with roughly a dozen routes sit at the exits — a transport-10 built on adjacency and buses rather than rail variety, since the BTS interchange is one stop north at Chatuchak Park. Rents track the Chatuchak blend (16,000-25,000 baht studios and small one-beds captured district-wide). The honest caveats: the 0.1 ha of mapped park means green 9 is buffer effect from parks centred in other units, the unit's nightlife and safety scores have no found evidence either way, and the market itself is mid-redevelopment after City Hall's 2025 clock-tower evictions.

strengths.en: Unmatched market access for a rail stop: direct exits into the weekend market and the daily Or Tor Kor market, plus roughly a dozen bus routes at two on-street stops.
MetroMall underground and a compact station footprint keep errands indoor-adjacent in rain or heat, at the district's mid-market rent level.

tradeoffs.en: MRT-only: no BTS interchange at the station (one stop away at BL13), ridership one-sixth of the neighbouring interchange, and the transport 10 depends on market/bus adjacency — confirm the rubric.
Green 9 is borrowed scenery: 0.1 ha mapped in-unit and no park centroid within 850 m; the park complex's centroids lie 1.1-1.5 km away in the mo-chit/chatuchak units.

dayNight.en: Weekdays belong to market logistics and Or Kor Tor's morning trade; Saturdays-Sundays the unit absorbs a 200,000-visitor surge that starts at the station exits and drains outward.

variation.en: The unit splits between the market's south-western edge (exits 1-2, weekend economy) and the Kamphaeng Phet 1 Road strip (exit 3, daily market, temple and school), with the park complex beyond the boundary to the west.

fit.en: Fit for market traders and staff, produce buyers, and bus-to-MRT transfer riders who value the market on the doorstep.
Poor fit for those who want the park as a daily amenity inside their own unit, multi-line rail variety, or verified nightlife.

uncertainties: App anchor 13.8049 sits ~770 m north of the OSM station node 13.7980, near Chatuchak Park MRT — reconcile the anchor convention (kamphaeng-phet-c01).
Transport 10 for an MRT-only stop rests on inference from exits/buses; rubric confirmation needed (kamphaeng-phet-c03).
